contentText:
Karol G remains strong at the No.1 spot, while Bad Bunny, Netón Vega, Lenin Ramirez, Jay Wheeler and Omar Courtz fill out the rest of the top 10.

Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 for the week dated September 26th! Lenin Ramirez grabs the No. 10 spot, Netón Vega holds at 9…Jay Wheeler dips to 8, Latin Mafia and Fred again.. are up to 7, “Matadora” slides to 6, “Koko” moves up to 5, as does “Ayúdame” to 4, Karol G and Drake are strong at No.3, while “DTMF” is solid at 2…and “Bby WOW” continues its domination with a fifth week at No.1!
